'''Wan Sandage's Podracer''' was the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned by the [[Devlikk/Legends|Devlikk]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]]. He piloted this racer during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
It had unique characteristics, including an almost-insectoid feel to its streamlined design, and two wings that bracketed the thin cockpit, which was crested by a large sail-like fin&mdash;a customization by Sandage himself. The small engines had scoop-like curved fairings on them directing air into the turbines. The racer boasted high traction and advanced braking systems.

==History==
As well as competing in the Boonta Eve Classic, Sandage also piloted his racer across tracks on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and [[Scrapper's Run/Legends|Scrapper's Run]] on [[Ord Ibanna]]. During the Boonta race, however, Sandage badly damaged his Podracer in a third-lap collision with a wayward [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. Fortunately for Sandage, he was able to salvage and repair his vehicle, and later piloted it in the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

Following his death, Sandage's son, [[Wan Sandage Jr.]], inherited his father's Podracer, and piloted it in races held [[24 BBY/Legends|two years]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
